description:
[Trading Data API] Real-time web search for agents: ranked results with title, URL, snippet and score, plus an optional synthesized answer — Real-time web search for agents: ranked results with title, URL, snippet and score, plus an optional synthesized answer. Pay per search; general or news topic.

**Example:** `/v1/web-search?q=latest+ethereum+upgrade&max_results=5&topic=news`

include_answer.description: Optional. true (default) or false to skip the synthesized answer.

name: web_search
